item.content:encoded:
The WTPO Awards 2027 are now open, offering Trade Promotion Organizations (TPOs) from around the world an opportunity to showcase innovative initiatives that strengthen exports, support businesses, improve SME competitiveness, and contribute to sustainable economic development.

Organized through the International Trade Centre (ITC), the WTPO Awards have been bringing together the global trade promotion community for nearly three decades. The 2027 edition provides participating organizations with opportunities to gain international recognition, demonstrate measurable impact, exchange good practices, and connect with trade promotion leaders from around the world.

The 2027 awards feature three main categories covering partnerships, technology, and inclusive and sustainable trade. A new TPO Trailblazer Award has also been introduced for organizations implementing concrete changes based on their TPO Roadmaps for Excellence.

The Stage 1 application deadline is November 15, 2026.

What Are the WTPO Awards 2027?

The WTPO Awards recognize outstanding Trade Promotion Organizations that demonstrate excellence in developing and implementing initiatives designed to strengthen international trade.

For nearly 30 years, the International Trade Centre has brought TPOs together to celebrate achievements, exchange knowledge, share successful practices, and strengthen the international trade promotion community.

The awards focus on initiatives that can demonstrate meaningful contributions to areas such as:

  • Export development
  • SME competitiveness
  • Digital transformation
  • Partnerships and collaboration
  • Inclusive economic growth
  • Sustainable trade
  • Implementation of the UN Sustainable Development Goals
  • Innovative approaches to trade promotion

The awards therefore provide a platform for TPOs to demonstrate how their initiatives are addressing practical challenges faced by exporters and businesses.

WTPO Awards 2027 at a Glance

Feature Details
Opportunity WTPO Awards 2027
Organizer International Trade Centre (ITC)
Target participants Trade Promotion Organizations
Main award categories Three
Special distinction TPO Trailblazer Award
Stage 1 deadline November 15, 2026
Qualifying applicants confirmed December 21, 2026
Stage 2 deadline February 26, 2027
Shortlisted finalists announced May 4, 2027
Winners announced May 25, 2027
Main event Global SME Ministerial & TPO Leadership Dialogue
Geographic scope Global

What Is a Trade Promotion Organization?

Trade Promotion Organizations, commonly known as TPOs, work to support businesses and strengthen their ability to participate in international markets.

Depending on their national or regional mandate, TPOs may help businesses with activities such as:

  • Export development
  • Market access
  • Internationalization
  • Export readiness
  • Trade information
  • Business connections
  • International market intelligence
  • SME support
  • Investment and trade promotion

The WTPO Awards provide these organizations with a platform to showcase initiatives that have generated meaningful results in these areas.

The Three WTPO Awards 2027 Categories

The 2027 edition features three principal award categories. Organizations should consider which category most closely corresponds to the initiative they wish to submit.

1. Best Use of Partnerships

The Best Use of Partnerships category recognizes initiatives that effectively use partnerships and collaborative networks to strengthen export development and increase impact.

Trade promotion frequently requires cooperation between multiple stakeholders. These can include government institutions, private-sector organizations, business associations, financial institutions, international organizations, research institutions, and other partners.

This category provides an opportunity for TPOs to demonstrate how collaboration has helped them achieve stronger results than they could have achieved independently.

Examples of partnership-related approaches may include:

  • Developing collaborative export programs
  • Building networks that connect businesses with international markets
  • Working with public and private-sector partners
  • Establishing strategic collaborations
  • Coordinating initiatives involving multiple stakeholders
  • Using partnerships to expand the reach of trade promotion services

Applicants should use their submission to demonstrate how partnerships contributed to the initiative’s objectives and impact.

2. Best Use of Technology

The Best Use of Technology category recognizes innovative digital solutions that improve productivity, service delivery, client engagement, and exporter support.

Technology is increasingly transforming the way organizations interact with businesses and deliver trade-related services.

TPOs using technology to make their services more accessible, efficient, responsive, or data-driven can use this category to showcase their initiatives.

Potential areas may include:

  • Digital exporter support platforms
  • Online trade services
  • Digital market intelligence
  • Technology-enabled client engagement
  • Digital tools for SMEs
  • Online training and capacity building
  • Digital systems that improve organizational productivity
  • Technology that makes export services more accessible

The emphasis is on how technology has been applied to improve outcomes for the organization and the businesses it supports.

3. Best Initiative for Inclusive and Sustainable Trade

The Best Initiative for Inclusive and Sustainable Trade category recognizes initiatives that advance inclusive growth, sustainable trade, and the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

This category provides an opportunity for TPOs to highlight programs that address broader economic, social, and environmental objectives alongside trade development.

Relevant initiatives may demonstrate contributions toward:

  • Inclusive economic growth
  • Sustainable trade
  • Sustainable business practices
  • SME development
  • Greater participation in international markets
  • Broader economic opportunities
  • Contributions to the UN Sustainable Development Goals

Organizations considering this category should clearly explain how their initiative contributes to inclusive and sustainable development.

Apply HERE

New for 2027: TPO Trailblazer Award

The WTPO Awards 2027 introduces a new distinction: the TPO Trailblazer Award.

This award is separate from the three main WTPO Award categories.

The Trailblazer Award recognizes TPOs that are turning commitments into concrete action by implementing changes aligned with their TPO Roadmaps for Excellence.

These roadmaps were developed as an outcome of the 2025 TPO Leadership Dialogue.

How Is the Trailblazer Award Different?

The Trailblazer Award has several distinctions from the three main WTPO Awards:

  • It has its own evaluation criteria.
  • It follows a separate evaluation process.
  • It is not assessed by the WTPO Awards jury.
  • It is conferred by the Executive Director of the International Trade Centre.
  • It focuses specifically on concrete changes associated with TPO Roadmaps for Excellence.

Organizations can apply for both the main WTPO Awards and the Trailblazer Award.

Importantly, the two applications are independent. Applying for one does not affect eligibility for the other.

Learn more about the TPO Trailblazer Award

What Is the TPO Leadership Dialogue?

The TPO Leadership Dialogue is a high-level international forum that brings together leaders of national trade and investment promotion organizations as well as senior trade representatives from around the world.

The Dialogue creates a space for participants to:

  • Exchange experiences
  • Discuss emerging challenges
  • Explore opportunities in trade promotion
  • Strengthen relationships
  • Develop partnerships
  • Share institutional experiences
  • Discuss developments affecting trade promotion organizations

The WTPO Awards finalists will be announced at the TPO Leadership Dialogue.

The Dialogue also provides an opportunity for TPO leaders to interact with ministers, policymakers, and representatives of the private sector.

Connection With the Global SME Ministerial

The TPO Leadership Dialogue is held alongside the Global SME Ministerial.

This creates an additional opportunity for trade promotion leaders to connect with:

  • Ministers
  • Policymakers
  • Private-sector representatives
  • Trade promotion organizations
  • International stakeholders

The combination of the Leadership Dialogue and Global SME Ministerial creates a setting for discussions connecting trade promotion with broader SME and trade policy priorities.

A Global History of the WTPO Awards and Leadership Dialogue

The WTPO Awards and TPO Leadership Dialogue have travelled across different regions of the world over the years.

Previous host cities and editions include:

  • 1996 — Cartagena, Colombia
  • 1998 — Santiago, Chile
  • 2000 — Marrakech, Morocco
  • 2002 — Beijing, China
  • 2004 — St. Julian’s, Malta
  • 2007 — Buenos Aires, Argentina
  • 2008 — The Hague, Netherlands
  • 2010 — Mexico City, Mexico
  • 2012 — Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
  • 2014 — Dubai, UAE
  • 2016 — Marrakech, Morocco
  • 2018 — Paris, France
  • 2022 — Accra, Ghana
  • 2025 — Johannesburg, South Africa

This history reflects the international nature of the WTPO community and the program’s focus on bringing trade promotion organizations together across different regions.

What Happened at the 2025 TPO Leadership Dialogue?

The first TPO Leadership Dialogue in its new format took place on July 22, 2025, alongside the inaugural Global SME Ministerial Meeting in Johannesburg, South Africa.

The event concluded with a gala ceremony recognizing the WTPO Awards winners.

The 2024 WTPO winners celebrated at the 2025 ceremony included:

  • Business France
  • Switzerland Global Enterprise
  • ApexBrasil

The runners-up included:

  • PROCOMER
  • ProDominicana
  • NIPDB

The previous edition provides context for the international recognition associated with the WTPO Awards.

Why Should Trade Promotion Organizations Apply?

Participation in the WTPO Awards is an opportunity for organizations to present their work to an international audience of trade promotion professionals and stakeholders.

According to the program information, participating organizations can use the awards to:

Gain International Recognition

The awards provide a platform for organizations to showcase outstanding initiatives and achievements internationally.

Demonstrate Impact

Participation allows TPOs to demonstrate the results of their initiatives to governments, partners, stakeholders, and the wider trade promotion community.

Benchmark Initiatives

Organizations can compare their approaches and experiences with those of other TPOs from around the world.

Share Innovative Practices

The awards provide an opportunity to share approaches that other trade promotion organizations may find useful or adaptable.

Increase Visibility

Selected initiatives can receive exposure through ITC’s international communication channels.

Receive Expert Feedback

The application process can provide feedback that organizations can use to strengthen future initiatives.

Application Guide for the WTPO Awards 2027

Applicants are encouraged to download and review the official WTPO Awards 2027 Application Guide before preparing their submissions.

The guide provides important information about:

  • Eligibility requirements
  • Application procedures
  • Evaluation criteria
  • Frequently asked questions
  • Submission requirements

Download the WTPO Awards 2027 Application Guide

Reviewing the guide carefully is particularly important because the application process involves multiple stages.

WTPO Awards 2027 Application Process and Key Dates

The 2027 awards process follows a series of important milestones.

September 21, 2026 — Call for Applications

The WTPO Awards 2027 officially launched and applications opened.

November 15, 2026 — Stage 1 Application Deadline

This is the first major deadline for organizations interested in participating.

Deadline: November 15, 2026

Organizations should ensure their Stage 1 application is completed and submitted before the deadline.

December 21, 2026 — Qualifying Applicants Confirmed

Applicants who meet the qualifying requirements are expected to be confirmed and informed on this date.

February 26, 2027 — Stage 2 Application Deadline

Qualified applicants proceed to the second stage, with the Stage 2 application deadline scheduled for February 26, 2027.

May 4, 2027 — Shortlisted Finalists Announced

The shortlisted finalists are scheduled to be announced on May 4, 2027.

May 25, 2027 — Winners Announced

The winners will be announced at the Global SME Ministerial and TPO Leadership Dialogue on May 25, 2027.

How to Prepare a Strong WTPO Awards Application

Trade Promotion Organizations preparing an application should carefully consider how their initiative aligns with the relevant award category.

A strong preparation process can include the following steps.

1. Identify the Initiative

Clearly define the initiative that the organization wants to showcase.

The initiative should be connected to the objectives of one of the award categories.

2. Select the Most Appropriate Category

Consider whether the initiative most closely relates to:

  • Partnerships
  • Technology
  • Inclusive and sustainable trade

Organizations applying separately for the Trailblazer Award should also review its specific requirements.

3. Demonstrate Results

Applicants should be prepared to explain what the initiative achieved and how its impact can be demonstrated.

Relevant evidence may include measurable outcomes, changes in service delivery, improvements for exporters, partnerships established, or other appropriate indicators.

4. Explain the Innovation or Approach

The application should clearly communicate what makes the initiative distinctive and how it addresses a particular trade promotion challenge.

5. Connect the Initiative With Broader Objectives

Depending on the category, applicants should explain connections to export development, SME competitiveness, digital transformation, inclusion, sustainability, or the SDGs.

6. Review the Official Evaluation Criteria

Before submitting an application, organizations should consult the official application guide and make sure their submission addresses the applicable evaluation criteria.

How to Apply for the WTPO Awards 2027

Organizations interested in applying can begin by reviewing the official application guide and then accessing the online application platform.

Step 1: Review the Application Guide

Understand the eligibility requirements, categories, evaluation process, and submission requirements.

Step 2: Select Your Award Category

Choose the category that best corresponds to the initiative being submitted.

Step 3: Prepare the Application

Collect the necessary information and supporting material required for Stage 1.

Step 4: Submit Before November 15, 2026

Ensure that the Stage 1 application is submitted before the official deadline.

Step 5: Monitor the Selection Process

Qualifying applicants are scheduled to be informed on December 21, 2026, followed by the Stage 2 application process.

Apply for the WTPO Awards 2027

How to Apply for the TPO Trailblazer Award

Organizations interested in the newly introduced Trailblazer Award have a separate application process.

The Trailblazer Award application is independent of the three main WTPO Awards categories.

Organizations can therefore apply for both programs without one application affecting the eligibility of the other.

Download the TPO Trailblazer Award Application Guide

Apply for the TPO Trailblazer Award

Previous WTPO Award Winners

The WTPO Awards have previously recognized organizations for their achievements in trade promotion.

The 2024 winners recognized at the 2025 gala ceremony were:

  • Business France
  • Switzerland Global Enterprise
  • ApexBrasil

Their participation demonstrates the international scope of the awards and the variety of organizations involved in the global trade promotion community.

Frequently Asked Questions About WTPO Awards 2027

What are the WTPO Awards?

The WTPO Awards recognize outstanding Trade Promotion Organizations that demonstrate excellence in export development and related areas.

Who organizes the WTPO Awards?

The awards are organized through the International Trade Centre (ITC).

Who can participate?

The opportunity is designed for Trade Promotion Organizations rather than individual applicants.

How many main award categories are there?

There are three main categories:

  1. Best Use of Partnerships
  2. Best Use of Technology
  3. Best Initiative for Inclusive and Sustainable Trade

There is also a separate TPO Trailblazer Award for 2027.

What is the deadline for Stage 1?

The Stage 1 application deadline is November 15, 2026.

When is the Stage 2 deadline?

The Stage 2 application deadline is February 26, 2027.

When will finalists be announced?

Shortlisted finalists are scheduled to be announced on May 4, 2027.

When will the winners be announced?

The winners are scheduled to be announced on May 25, 2027, at the Global SME Ministerial and TPO Leadership Dialogue.

Can an organization apply for both the WTPO Awards and Trailblazer Award?

Yes. The two applications are independent, and applying for one does not affect eligibility for the other.

Where can applicants get assistance?

Questions about the WTPO Awards or application process can be directed to wtpo-awards@intracen.org.

Learn more HERE

Conclusion

The WTPO Awards 2027 provide Trade Promotion Organizations with an international platform to showcase initiatives that strengthen exports, improve SME competitiveness, encourage innovation, and support inclusive and sustainable economic development.

The three main award categories allow organizations to highlight achievements in partnerships, technology, and inclusive and sustainable trade, while the new TPO Trailblazer Award introduces a separate distinction for organizations putting their TPO Roadmaps for Excellence into practice.

With the 2027 awards bringing together the global trade promotion community through the TPO Leadership Dialogue and Global SME Ministerial, the program also provides opportunities for knowledge exchange, institutional networking, and international visibility.

Organizations interested in participating should review the official application guide carefully and prepare their Stage 1 submission ahead of the November 15, 2026 deadline. Further stages will follow in 2027, culminating in the announcement of the winners on May 25, 2027.

item.content:encoded:
The Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) 2027–28 offers an opportunity for outstanding students from around the world to pursue doctoral studies in Hong Kong. Lingnan University is among the participating universities that can nominate exceptional PhD applicants for consideration under the fellowship scheme.

Established by the Research Grants Council (RGC) of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in 2009, the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme was created to attract high-achieving students from around the world to undertake PhD studies at Hong Kong universities.

For the 2027–28 academic year, the scheme is accepting applications from 1 September 2026 until 1 December 2026 at 12:00 noon Hong Kong Time for the initial RGC application. Applicants seeking admission to PhD programmes through the scheme must also complete their full university application by the university’s stated deadline.

At Lingnan University, the full application deadline for applicants applying through the HKPFS is 1 December 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Hong Kong Time. Late applications will not be accepted.

What Is the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme?

The Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme is a doctoral fellowship initiative established by the Research Grants Council to attract outstanding students internationally to pursue full-time PhD studies at participating universities in Hong Kong.

The scheme is designed for applicants who demonstrate strong academic and research potential as well as qualities that can contribute to their future academic, professional, and leadership development.

The official RGC describes the scheme as being open to applicants seeking admission as new full-time PhD students, regardless of their country of origin, prior work experience, or ethnic background. Applicants are expected to demonstrate outstanding academic performance, research ability or potential, communication and interpersonal skills, and leadership abilities.

For prospective doctoral students looking to undertake advanced research in Hong Kong, the HKPFS provides a route through which they can apply for both PhD admission and consideration for a competitive fellowship award.

Lingnan University and the HKPFS

Lingnan University is one of the universities participating in the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme.

For the 2027–28 admission cycle, Lingnan University will assess applicants to its PhD programmes and nominate outstanding applicants for consideration for the Hong Kong PhD Fellowships.

The selection process therefore involves more than simply submitting an application to Lingnan University. Applicants first complete the required initial application through the RGC’s Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme system. They then submit a full PhD application to their selected university or universities.

Lingnan University conducts its own selection of PhD applicants and nominates outstanding candidates for the fellowship. The RGC then uses selection panels to assess the nominations submitted by participating institutions.

This means applicants should pay close attention to both the HKPFS application requirements and Lingnan University’s PhD admission requirements.

Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme 2027–28 Funding

One of the major features of the fellowship is its financial support.

For the 2026–27 rate stated by Lingnan University, each fellowship awardee receives:

  • HK$28,700 monthly stipend, subject to annual review
  • Up to HK$14,400 per year for conference and research-related travel
  • Fellowship support for a maximum period of three years

Lingnan University’s announcement further states that where an awardee has a normative study period of four years, the University will provide the same level of fellowship and conference/research-related travel allowance for the fourth year.

The Research Grants Council currently states the annual fellowship value as HK$344,400, equivalent to approximately HK$28,700 per month, together with a HK$14,400 annual conference and research-related travel allowance for up to three years.

The RGC notes that the stipend is subject to annual review.

What the Fellowship Funding Covers

The financial package is designed to support doctoral researchers during their PhD studies.

Monthly stipend

Awardees receive a monthly stipend intended to provide financial support throughout the fellowship period.

For the rate stated for 2026–27, the monthly amount is:

HK$28,700 per month

This corresponds to an annual stipend of:

HK$344,400 per year

Conference and research-related travel allowance

In addition to the monthly stipend, awardees receive an annual allowance of up to:

HK$14,400 per year

This is intended for conference and research-related travel.

Such funding can support doctoral researchers who need to participate in academic conferences, research activities, or other approved research-related travel.

Potential fourth-year support at Lingnan

The Lingnan University announcement contains an additional provision for PhD programmes with a normative study period of four years.

For an awardee whose programme has a four-year normative study period, Lingnan University states that it will provide the same level of fellowship and conference/research-related travel allowance for the fourth year.

Applicants should nevertheless confirm the applicable funding arrangements for their particular programme directly with Lingnan University.

Who Can Apply for the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme?

The HKPFS has an international eligibility scope.

The official Research Grants Council states that individuals seeking admission as new full-time PhD students at participating UGC-funded universities in Hong Kong may apply, irrespective of their country of origin, prior work experience, or ethnic background.

This means the opportunity is not restricted to applicants from Hong Kong or a particular continent.

Applicants from around the world can be considered, provided they satisfy the requirements of the fellowship and the specific PhD programme to which they apply.

Academic and Professional Qualities Expected

According to the RGC, applicants should demonstrate strength in several areas:

  1. Academic performance
  2. Research ability or research potential
  3. Communication and interpersonal skills
  4. Leadership abilities

Academic excellence is the primary consideration in the fellowship selection process, while research potential, communication and interpersonal skills, and leadership abilities are also taken into account.

Applicants should therefore present a strong academic and research profile rather than relying solely on their academic qualifications.

Is the Fellowship Open to Applicants From Africa?

Yes.

The official HKPFS eligibility information states that applicants are eligible irrespective of their country of origin.

Therefore, applicants from African countries, including applicants from countries such as Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Nigeria, Ghana, South Africa, Rwanda, Ethiopia, Zambia, Zimbabwe, and other African countries, can apply, provided they meet the relevant PhD programme admission requirements.

The scheme is similarly open to applicants from other regions around the world.

There is also no race or ethnic restriction stated by the RGC; its official eligibility statement specifically says eligibility applies irrespective of ethnic background.

Relevant Fields and PhD Programmes

The HKPFS is not limited to one academic discipline.

The RGC assesses shortlisted applicants through two broad selection areas:

Sciences, Medicine, Engineering and Technology

This panel covers research areas within the broad fields of:

  • Sciences
  • Medicine
  • Engineering
  • Technology

Humanities, Social Sciences and Business Studies

The second broad area covers:

  • Humanities
  • Social sciences
  • Business studies

The specific PhD programmes available to applicants depend on the participating university and its programme offerings.

Applicants should therefore identify a suitable PhD programme at Lingnan University and carefully review the programme-specific admission requirements before applying.

How the HKPFS Application Process Works

Applicants seeking the fellowship must complete the application process in stages.

Step 1: Submit the Initial HKPFS Application

Applicants must first submit an initial application through the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme Electronic System (HKPFSES) operated by the Research Grants Council.

For the 2027–28 cycle, the initial application period is:

1 September 2026 to 1 December 2026 at 12:00 noon Hong Kong Time.

Applicants who successfully complete the initial application receive an HKPFS reference number.

This reference number is important because it is subsequently used when submitting the full application to the selected university or universities.

Step 2: Submit the Full Application to Lingnan University

After completing the initial RGC application, applicants must submit their full PhD application directly to Lingnan University.

Lingnan University’s application instructions specify that applicants should quote the reference number assigned by the RGC for verification.

For the 2027–28 intake, applicants should select:

“HK PhD Fellowship Scheme (2027-28)”

as the application type in Lingnan University’s Online Admission System.

The full Lingnan University application must be submitted by:

1 December 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Hong Kong Time.

Lingnan University explicitly states that no late application will be accepted.

How Applicants Are Selected

The selection process takes place at both the university and fellowship levels.

First, Lingnan University conducts its own selection of applicants for its PhD programmes.

The University then nominates outstanding applicants for the Hong Kong PhD Fellowships.

After nominations are submitted, the RGC establishes selection panels to assess the nominated candidates.

The official RGC information states that shortlisted applications are reviewed according to their broad academic area by one of two selection panels:

  • Sciences, Medicine, Engineering and Technology
  • Humanities, Social Sciences and Business Studies

Individual universities may also conduct interviews as part of the assessment process.

What Are the Selection Criteria?

Academic excellence is the primary consideration in the fellowship selection process.

The RGC also considers:

  • Research ability and potential
  • Communication and interpersonal skills
  • Leadership abilities

Applicants should therefore present evidence of both academic achievement and the ability to contribute meaningfully to research and the wider academic community.

What Happens If You Do Not Receive the Fellowship?

Not receiving the HKPFS fellowship does not necessarily mean that an applicant’s PhD application at Lingnan University will automatically be rejected.

Lingnan University states that applicants who are:

  • nominated for the fellowship but are not finally awarded the fellowship, or
  • not selected for nomination for the fellowship,

may still be considered for admission as PhD students at Lingnan University and may take up places assigned to the University with Postgraduate Studentship awards.

The broader RGC guidance similarly states that candidates who are not selected for the HKPFS may be accepted by participating universities for regular PhD admission and may receive postgraduate studentships, subject to the university’s assessment and admission requirements.

This creates a distinction between:

  • admission to the PhD programme, and
  • receiving the HKPFS fellowship.

Applicants should therefore understand that the fellowship selection and ordinary university admission are related but distinct processes.

Lingnan University Direct PhD Admission Option

Lingnan University also offers a separate route for applicants who wish to apply directly to the University’s PhD programmes rather than through the HKPFS.

According to Lingnan University’s 2027–28 admission information, PhD applicants can apply in two ways:

  1. Through the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme
  2. Through Direct Admissions to the University

Successful applicants through the direct admission route will normally receive a Postgraduate Studentship with a monthly stipend of HK$19,280 under the stated 2026–27 rate, with the amount subject to revision after confirmation of candidature.

Applicants should select the appropriate application route carefully because the University states that applications cannot be transferred from one route to the other after submission.

Application Limits

Applicants should also pay attention to Lingnan University’s application restrictions.

Each applicant may apply for a maximum of two programmes.

The University states that this restriction also applies where an applicant submits applications through both the HKPFS and Direct Admissions routes.

The RGC similarly states that HKPFS applicants may choose up to two programmes or departments at one or two universities.

Applicants must ensure that they select the correct application type and provide accurate and complete information.

Lingnan University states that an application submitted through one route cannot later be transferred to the other route, and application fees paid are non-refundable and non-transferable.

Important Integrity and Application Rules

Applicants are expected to provide accurate and authentic information throughout the application process.

Lingnan University states that false or misleading information or documents, dishonest conduct, plagiarism, and other forms of misconduct can result in consequences including disqualification, withdrawal of an admission offer, or termination of studies if the applicant has already been admitted.

The University also states that falsification of documents is not tolerated and highlights Hong Kong’s laws concerning forgery.

Applicants and their representatives are also prohibited from offering advantages to University staff or members in relation to admission applications.

Prospective applicants should therefore ensure that every document submitted is accurate, authentic, and properly prepared.

Do Not Use Unauthorised Admission Agents

Lingnan University’s admission information contains an important warning concerning third-party recruitment.

The University states that its School of Graduate Studies has not authorised any third party for admissions or recruitment work involving research postgraduate students.

Applicants should therefore exercise caution if someone claims to represent Lingnan University or offers to guarantee admission or fellowship selection in exchange for payment.

The safest approach is to use the official university and Research Grants Council application systems.

Important Considerations for International Applicants

Because the HKPFS accepts applicants regardless of country of origin, it is an international opportunity.

However, international applicants must still satisfy the admission requirements of the specific university and PhD programme they select.

The RGC explicitly notes that applicants are required to comply fully with the admission requirements of their selected universities and programmes.

Therefore, being eligible to apply for the HKPFS does not automatically mean that an applicant meets the academic or programme-specific requirements for every PhD programme.

Applicants should check:

  • The specific PhD programme
  • Academic qualifications required
  • Research requirements
  • Supporting documents
  • Language requirements, where applicable
  • Programme-specific deadlines
  • University application procedures
  • Any additional requirements imposed by the department or faculty

Key Benefits of the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme

The fellowship offers several major benefits to successful awardees.

Financial Support

Awardees receive a monthly stipend of HK$28,700 under the stated 2026–27 rate, subject to annual review.

Research and Conference Travel Support

Awardees receive up to HK$14,400 per year for conference and research-related travel.

International PhD Study

The scheme allows successful candidates from around the world to pursue doctoral studies at participating Hong Kong universities.

Research Development

PhD study provides an opportunity to undertake advanced research within a university environment and contribute to the applicant’s academic and professional development.

Potential Continued Support

For Lingnan University programmes with a normative four-year study period, the University states that the same level of fellowship and travel allowance will be offered for the fourth year.

Alternative Postgraduate Studentship Consideration

Candidates who are not ultimately selected for the fellowship may still be considered for regular PhD admission and postgraduate studentship support, subject to the University’s assessment.

Key Dates for HKPFS 2027–28

Stage Date
HKPFS application opens 1 September 2026
RGC initial application deadline 1 December 2026, 12:00 noon HKT
Lingnan University full application deadline 1 December 2026, 11:59 p.m. HKT
Academic year 2027–28

The RGC confirms that the 2027–28 HKPFS application period runs from 1 September 2026 to 1 December 2026 at 12:00 noon Hong Kong Time.

HKPFS 2027–28 at Lingnan University: Quick Facts

Feature Details
Opportunity Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme
University featured Lingnan University
Academic level PhD
Study mode Full-time
Academic year 2027–28
Monthly stipend HK$28,700 under the stated 2026–27 rate
Annual stipend equivalent HK$344,400
Travel allowance Up to HK$14,400 per year
Fellowship duration Maximum 3 years
Lingnan fourth-year provision Same level of support for normative four-year programmes
Applicants New full-time PhD applicants
Nationality Applicants from all countries
Ethnic background No restriction stated
Work experience No restriction based on prior work experience
Selection considerations Academic excellence, research ability/potential, communication/interpersonal skills, leadership
Initial RGC deadline 1 December 2026, 12:00 noon HKT
Lingnan full application deadline 1 December 2026, 11:59 p.m. HKT
Late applications Not accepted

How to Apply for the Lingnan University HKPFS

Applicants interested in the Lingnan University opportunity should follow the application process carefully.

Step 1: Identify an appropriate PhD programme

Review Lingnan University’s available research postgraduate programmes and identify a PhD programme that matches your academic background and research interests.

Step 2: Review programme requirements

Check the specific admission requirements for the selected PhD programme.

The RGC makes clear that applicants must comply with the requirements of their selected university and programme.

Step 3: Submit the initial HKPFS application

Submit the initial application through the official RGC HKPFS Electronic System.

The initial application deadline is:

1 December 2026 at 12:00 noon Hong Kong Time.

Step 4: Obtain your HKPFS reference number

The RGC assigns applicants a reference number after the initial application.

Step 5: Submit the Lingnan University application

Complete the full Lingnan University application and quote the RGC reference number.

When applying through the University system, select:

“HK PhD Fellowship Scheme (2027-28)”

as the application type.

Step 6: Submit before the University deadline

The full Lingnan University application must be submitted by:

1 December 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Hong Kong Time.

Applicants should not assume that completing the RGC initial application alone completes the university application process.

APPLY HERE

Final Application Checklist

Before submitting an application, prospective applicants should ensure that they have:

  • Identified an appropriate Lingnan University PhD programme
  • Reviewed the programme-specific admission requirements
  • Prepared their academic records and supporting documents
  • Prepared their research materials
  • Completed the RGC HKPFS initial application
  • Obtained their HKPFS reference number
  • Selected “HK PhD Fellowship Scheme (2027-28)” in the Lingnan application system
  • Submitted the full application to Lingnan University
  • Paid any required application fee
  • Checked that all information and documents are accurate
  • Submitted both applications before their respective deadlines

For any enquiry,Click here to contact us.

Application Deadline

There are two important deadlines applicants should keep in mind.

RGC Initial Application Deadline

1 December 2026 at 12:00 noon Hong Kong Time

This is the deadline for the initial HKPFS application through the Research Grants Council’s online system.

Lingnan University Full Application Deadline

1 December 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Hong Kong Time

This is the deadline for submitting the full application to Lingnan University.

Important

These are different deadlines on the same date.

Applicants should not wait until the final hours to begin the process. The RGC specifically advises applicants to submit their initial application as early as possible so they have sufficient time to complete their university applications.

Click HERE for more information about Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme 2027–28 at Lingnan University.

Conclusion

The Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme 2027–28 at Lingnan University provides an international pathway for outstanding prospective doctoral students seeking to pursue full-time PhD study in Hong Kong.

The scheme is open to applicants regardless of country of origin, prior work experience, or ethnic background, provided they are seeking admission as new full-time PhD students and can satisfy the relevant fellowship and university requirements. The RGC highlights academic excellence, research ability or potential, communication and interpersonal skills, and leadership abilities among the qualities considered during selection.

For the stated 2026–27 funding level, successful fellows receive a HK$28,700 monthly stipend and up to HK$14,400 annually for conference and research-related travel, with fellowship support available for up to three years. Lingnan University additionally states that awardees in programmes with a normative four-year study period will receive the same level of fellowship and travel allowance for the fourth year.

The application process requires careful attention because there are two important submissions. Applicants must first complete the RGC initial application by 1 December 2026 at 12:00 noon Hong Kong Time, followed by the full Lingnan University application by 1 December 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Hong Kong Time. Lingnan University explicitly states that late applications will not be accepted.

Prospective applicants should therefore begin preparing well in advance, identify an appropriate PhD programme, review its specific admission requirements, prepare a strong research profile, and carefully complete both stages of the application process.

Key deadline: 1 December 2026

RGC initial application: 12:00 noon Hong Kong Time
Lingnan University full application: 11:59 p.m. Hong Kong Time

item.content:encoded:
The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) is accepting applications for a highly experienced Technical Advisor to join its Regional Bureau for Africa in Pretoria, South Africa.

The position is an internationally recruited IPSA-11 appointment and is open to both internal and external candidates. It offers senior development professionals an opportunity to contribute directly to economic transformation, strategic development planning, development finance, public finance management, sustainable energy, regional trade, capacity development, and evidence-based policy formulation across Africa. UNjobnet

The Technical Advisor will work within the Regional Bureau for Africa’s Strategy, Analysis and Research Team, supporting countries and UNDP country offices with high-level policy advice, research, strategic analysis, knowledge management, partnerships, capacity strengthening, and policy solutions addressing some of the continent’s most complex development challenges. IGO Jobs

This opportunity is particularly relevant to senior economists, policy specialists, development professionals, strategic planners, public-finance specialists, development-finance experts, energy specialists, trade experts, and professionals with extensive experience working with African regional institutions.

About the United Nations Development Programme

UNDP is the United Nations’ global development organization, working with countries to reduce poverty and inequality, strengthen institutions, improve governance, build resilience, and advance sustainable development.

The organization works in nearly 170 countries and territories, connecting governments and communities with knowledge, expertise, partnerships, policy support, and development resources. changemaker

Within Africa, the Regional Bureau for Africa supports development priorities across 46 countries representing a wide range of economic and geographic circumstances, from least-developed to middle-income countries and from landlocked states to island economies. changemaker

The Bureau’s work supports African countries in pursuing their own national development objectives while aligning with major regional and global frameworks, including:

  • The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals
  • Agenda 2063
  • African Union development priorities
  • National development strategies
  • Regional economic integration initiatives

UNDP Strategic Plan 2026–2029

The Technical Advisor position sits within the context of UNDP’s 2026–2029 Strategic Plan.

The strategy is organized around four interconnected objectives:

  1. Prosperity for All
  2. Effective Governance
  3. Crisis Resilience
  4. A Healthy Planet

These priorities are supported by three major accelerators:

  • Digital and artificial intelligence transformation
  • Gender equality
  • Sustainable finance

Within Africa, these priorities are translated into the Regional Programme Document for 2026–2029, emphasizing structural transformation, stronger institutions, resilience, sustainable development, and implementation of Agenda 2063. changemaker

Purpose of the Technical Advisor Position

Development challenges increasingly require governments and development organizations to move beyond traditional coordination mechanisms.

Countries must simultaneously respond to economic shocks, climate change, debt pressures, digital transformation, employment challenges, changing trade patterns, energy transitions, demographic shifts, governance demands, and emerging geopolitical risks.

UNDP’s Technical Advisors are intended to strengthen the organization’s capacity to respond to these interconnected challenges through targeted technical expertise, policy analysis, strategic foresight, and access to professional networks.

The successful candidate will support African governments and UNDP country offices in developing practical, evidence-based approaches to national and regional development challenges. StandbyRoster

Key Technical Areas

Applicants must demonstrate substantial expertise in at least one of the following major areas.

1. Strategic Planning

Relevant experience may include:

  • National development planning
  • Regional development strategies
  • Policy design
  • Implementation frameworks
  • Development-plan assessment
  • Impact assessment
  • Strategic foresight
  • Alignment of national development policies

The role requires the ability to connect long-term national priorities with practical implementation and measurable development outcomes. UNjobs

2. Structural Economic Transformation

Professionals specializing in economic transformation may bring expertise in areas such as:

  • Macroeconomic analysis
  • Economic reform
  • Public finance management
  • Economic diversification
  • Natural-resource governance
  • Employment and growth
  • Structural transformation

The Technical Advisor may be called upon to assess economic conditions and develop practical policy recommendations for governments and UNDP leadership.

3. Development Financing

Development finance represents another major technical focus.

Relevant experience may include:

  • Innovative financing mechanisms
  • Sovereign and external debt
  • Development bonds
  • Development financing strategies
  • Mobilizing public and private capital
  • Reducing borrowing costs
  • Sustainable finance

The role is particularly relevant as African governments seek new approaches to financing development while responding to debt and fiscal pressures. UNjobs

4. Sustainable and Affordable Energy

Candidates may also specialize in energy-related development.

Relevant areas include:

  • Sustainable energy systems
  • Energy accessibility
  • Energy equity
  • Regional energy pools
  • Energy financing
  • Energy-transition strategies
  • Optimal energy mixes

The advisor may support policy development connecting energy access with economic growth, resilience, climate priorities, and regional integration.

5. Regional Trade

The fifth major specialization concerns African regional trade.

Relevant areas include:

  • Regional value chains
  • African Continental Free Trade Area implementation
  • Regional economic integration
  • Tariff barriers
  • Non-tariff barriers
  • Trade policy
  • Cross-border economic development

Experience relating to the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) and Regional Economic Communities can be especially relevant. UNjobs

Major Responsibilities

High-Level Policy Advice

The Technical Advisor will provide senior officials with practical, evidence-based analysis addressing complex development problems.

This may involve examining economic and development trends, evaluating policy choices, and preparing recommendations for governments and UNDP leadership.

The advisor will also analyze how international developments, economic shocks, geopolitical changes, and other emerging trends could affect African countries’ ability to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals. changemaker

Research and Economic Analysis

Research will form a substantial part of the position.

The Technical Advisor will analyze relevant:

  • Economic data
  • Financial information
  • Environmental indicators
  • Development trends
  • Regional conditions
  • Emerging risks

The resulting analysis will support diagnostic tools, policy recommendations, strategic planning, and development programming.

The role also includes contributing to technical and institutional publications, including development reports produced at global, regional, or national level. changemaker

Supporting National and Regional Development Strategies

The advisor will help transform research findings into actionable policy options.

This may involve preparing technical reports covering challenges and opportunities within African economies and using the findings to support national and regional development strategies.

The emphasis is not simply on academic research. UNDP is seeking expertise capable of translating evidence into solutions that governments and development institutions can implement.

Knowledge Management

The successful candidate will help organize and expand networks of regional expertise that can support UNDP country offices.

Responsibilities include:

  • Connecting country offices with relevant specialists
  • Supporting development-plan design
  • Strengthening development programming
  • Ensuring the quality of technical knowledge products
  • Aligning research and knowledge products with national priorities
  • Sharing lessons and expertise across countries

The advisor will therefore operate both as a technical specialist and as a connector between institutions and professional networks. changemaker

Strategic Positioning of UNDP

The Technical Advisor will provide authoritative advice concerning emerging trends and future opportunities.

The position involves building productive working relationships with:

  • African governments
  • UNDP country offices
  • UNDP regional teams
  • Other UNDP bureaus
  • Regional organizations
  • Research institutions
  • Policy organizations
  • Development partners

The advisor will also help communicate the results and impact of Regional Bureau for Africa programmes.

Partnerships and Professional Networks

An important element of the assignment is strengthening partnerships with research and policy institutions.

The Technical Advisor will participate in conferences, policy forums, workshops, expert meetings, and other professional platforms that can help strengthen knowledge exchange and UNDP’s development advisory capacity. changemaker

Representation at Regional and Global Forums

The successful candidate may represent the Regional Bureau for Africa in regional and international forums.

The advisor may also prepare high-level briefings for RBA leadership and identify policy options that improve the effectiveness of UNDP interventions across Africa. UNjobs

Capacity Development and Mentoring

The role includes designing and implementing strategies that strengthen technical competencies within UNDP country offices.

This means the Technical Advisor will not only provide direct expertise but also help develop sustainable institutional capacity within teams.

Education Requirements

Applicants must meet one of two educational pathways.

Master’s Degree Route

Candidates may hold an advanced university degree, such as a master’s degree or equivalent, from an internationally recognized institution in:

  • Business Administration
  • Public Administration
  • Economics
  • Political Sciences
  • Social Sciences
  • Another closely related discipline

Bachelor’s Degree Route

Applicants holding a first-level university degree in a relevant field may also be considered, provided they possess an additional two years of qualifying professional experience beyond the requirement applicable to master’s-degree holders.

An earned doctorate from an internationally recognized university in a relevant subject is considered desirable. changemaker

Professional Experience Requirements

Candidates with a master’s degree must have at least:

7 years of progressively responsible professional experience.

Candidates applying with a bachelor’s degree must have at least:

9 years of qualifying professional experience.

Relevant experience should be in areas such as:

  • Project management
  • Programme coordination
  • Capacity-building initiatives
  • Policy advisory work
  • Development programmes
  • Related professional fields changemaker

Required Professional Experience

Competitive candidates should demonstrate substantial experience working with African regional institutions.

Examples include:

  • African Union
  • Regional Economic Communities
  • Civil society organizations
  • Policy institutes
  • Think tanks

Applicants should also have demonstrated experience in project management, programme coordination, and implementation of capacity-development initiatives. changemaker

Candidates need a strong understanding of major cross-cutting development challenges affecting Africa, including areas such as:

  • Governance
  • Youth development
  • Gender equality
  • Economic transformation
  • Institutional development

Experience in strategic communication and partnership development is also required.

Desirable Experience

Additional experience that can strengthen an application includes:

  • Working with United Nations agencies
  • Working with national governments
  • Engagement with NGOs
  • Collaboration with civil society organizations
  • Experience with international public organizations
  • Familiarity with capacity-building methodologies
  • Knowledge of institutional capacity assessment
  • Advising senior leadership on programme management
  • Extensive experience with African regional institutions changemaker

Language Requirements

Applicants must be fluent in English.

Knowledge of either:

  • French, or
  • Portuguese

is desirable. changemaker

These language skills can be particularly valuable given the geographic scope of UNDP’s Regional Bureau for Africa.

Core Competencies

The position requires senior-level competency across several areas.

UNDP identifies seven major core competencies:

  • Achieve Results
  • Think Innovatively
  • Learn Continuously
  • Adapt with Agility
  • Act with Determination
  • Engage and Partner
  • Enable Diversity and Inclusion

The vacancy classifies these competencies at Level 3, reflecting the senior technical and advisory nature of the assignment. changemaker

Technical and Cross-Functional Skills

The role also emphasizes several specialist competencies.

Systems Thinking

Candidates should be able to examine complex systems and understand how policy, financing, governance, economics, institutions, and other elements interact.

Strategic Thinking

The advisor must be able to convert broad development objectives into prioritized strategies and practical solutions.

Collective Intelligence

The position requires the ability to bring together different stakeholders, data sources, expertise, information, and technologies to solve complex problems.

Data Analysis

Candidates should be able to analyze and interpret data to generate meaningful insights that support decision-making.

Relationship Management

A substantial part of the assignment involves developing and sustaining relationships with governments, regional institutions, development partners, researchers, and other stakeholders.

Storytelling and Communication

The advisor should be able to communicate complex technical information through clear and compelling narratives.

Results-Based Management

Applicants should understand how to manage programmes and strategies around measurable performance and demonstrable development outcomes. changemaker

Position Location and Contract

The position is based in:

Pretoria, South Africa

The current vacancy is listed as:

International Personnel Services Agreement – Regular, Full Time

Current UN vacancy databases classify the appointment at IPSA-11, which indicates a senior internationally recruited specialist-level role. UNjobnet

A salary figure has not been publicly listed in the current vacancy information. changemaker

UNDP’s Tiered Recruitment Approach

UNDP uses a tiered recruitment system for many vacancies.

Broadly:

  • Tier 0 covers certain existing personnel whose posts are being abolished or contracts ending.
  • Tier 1 includes other permanent and fixed-term UNDP, UNCDF, or UNV staff.
  • Tier 2 covers personnel on temporary appointments, regular PSA contracts, and certain UN Volunteers.
  • Tier 3 or vacancies with no restricted tier can include other UN personnel and external applicants.

This particular vacancy is explicitly titled “Open to Internal & External applicants,” making it available beyond existing UNDP personnel. changemaker

Equal Opportunity and Diversity

UNDP states that it values diversity reflecting the different countries and cultures in which it works.

Qualified applicants from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply, with recruitment decisions based on professional merit and suitability.

UNDP also maintains policies against discrimination, harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority. Selected applicants are subject to relevant screening and are expected to comply with UNDP standards of professional conduct. changemaker

Important Application Deadline

The current official-feed listing reports the closing deadline as:

6 October 2026 at 03:59 UTC. changemaker

Because this corresponds to 11:59 p.m. EDT on October 5, some vacancy databases display the deadline as October 5 rather than October 6. UNjobnet

Applicants should therefore submit their applications well before the final hours of October 5 to avoid timezone-related confusion or technical issues.

How to Apply

Applications should be submitted through the official UNDP Careers portal.

The vacancy identification number is:

Job Identification: 36845

Applicants should ensure that their application clearly demonstrates:

  1. The required academic qualification.
  2. At least seven or nine years of qualifying experience, depending on degree level.
  3. Expertise in one or more of the five designated technical areas.
  4. Experience with African regional institutions.
  5. Project and programme-management experience.
  6. Capacity-development experience.
  7. Strategic communications and partnership experience.
  8. Fluency in English.
  9. French or Portuguese ability, where applicable.
  10. Evidence of high-level policy analysis and advisory capability.

Apply through the official UNDP Careers portal

Important Advice for Applicants

This is a senior advisory position, so applications should be tailored accordingly.

Candidates should avoid submitting a generic development-sector CV. Instead, their application should clearly demonstrate measurable evidence of high-level policy work.

Strong applications may highlight examples such as:

  • National development strategies designed or evaluated
  • Governments advised
  • Economic reforms supported
  • Development-finance initiatives developed
  • Public-finance programmes managed
  • Regional trade projects delivered
  • Partnerships established with African institutions
  • Policy papers authored
  • Research influencing government decisions
  • Capacity-building programmes implemented
  • Senior officials briefed
  • Regional or international forums represented

Candidates should also quantify results wherever possible.

For example, rather than simply stating that they “supported regional development programmes,” applicants can explain the countries covered, size of programme portfolios, institutions involved, policies influenced, financing mobilized, or measurable development results achieved.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Applications

UNDP provides specific guidance on responsible use of artificial intelligence during recruitment and selection.

Applicants should therefore ensure that any use of AI supports rather than replaces their own authentic professional experience, qualifications, achievements, and responses. changemaker

Recruitment Fee Warning

UNDP does not charge applicants any fee at any stage of recruitment.

Candidates should be cautious of individuals or websites requesting payments in connection with UNDP employment opportunities. changemaker

Conclusion

The UNDP Technical Advisor opportunity in Pretoria, South Africa is a significant senior-level opening for experienced development professionals who want to contribute to policy transformation and sustainable development across Africa.

The role combines strategic policy advice, economic analysis, development planning, development finance, sustainable energy, regional trade, knowledge management, capacity development, partnerships, and high-level engagement with governments and regional institutions.

Applicants must possess substantial professional experience, with a minimum of seven years for master’s-degree holders or nine years for candidates applying with a bachelor’s degree. Strong experience working with African institutions and development challenges is essential, while expertise in strategic planning, economic transformation, development finance, energy, or regional trade will be particularly valuable. changemaker

The position is internationally recruited, based in Pretoria, and currently classified at the IPSA-11 level. Applications are open to both internal and external candidates. UNjobnet

The current deadline is 6 October 2026 at 03:59 UTC, and interested professionals are strongly encouraged to apply ahead of the cutoff.
